'''Am-Shak''' was the thunder [[Deity/Legends|god]] of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] religion, [[Sant]]. He was the brother of [[Quay (deity)|Quay]] and helped to watch over the prison of [[Quay'va]].<ref name="LoNH">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]''</ref>
